prose: Short note from feed metadata only: Axios (Will Maddox) reports that Midstream Health, whose AI tools help around 250 hospitals recover revenue from rebates and from vendor and payer underpayments, has raised a $20 million Series A led by Valtrius. The source is error-cached, so customer and product details beyond the synopsis are unverified.
